0.why: Alias.cpp:254 reads this input with getVoltage, which is channel 0 only
Alias.cpp:386 writes this output with setVoltage and no channel index, so it carries one channel

comment: The analysis is a 32768-point FFT with a Blackman-Harris window (Alias.cpp:46, :88 to :100). Each test frequency is snapped to an exact FFT bin so the measurement is synchronous (Alias.cpp:172 to :178). The fundamental is found within 5 per cent of where it is expected and each harmonic within 10 per cent, and eleven bins around each peak are summed and then zeroed, leaving only noise (Alias.cpp:284 to :339). No family is given for the SEND output because what it carries depends on the MODE switch: a ±5V sine in FX mode and a 1V per octave pitch in VCO mode (Alias.cpp:222 to :228).
